text: At the default tactical camera, Arad is still an octagon of equal square blocks with glowing tan outlines on a blank plain. The new 'villa quarter' to the east is a perfect ellipse of red-roofed houses around a loop lane, with a straight spur in. From above it reads as a racetrack or a stadium, which is the most procedural-looking object in the frame. The west lobe is a thin Y of sheds, and the walled compounds are lone square tiles. In S6 the town is still a band of silver-white boxes, not warm windows on dark massing. Next to Age of Empires IV and CS2 overviews, this is a first-glance prototype tell.

Three of the seven canonical frames are about 60% empty flat beige plane. S1's foreground is a uniform featureless surface, with nothing between the camera and the town. In S3 the plateau to the horizon is a single flat tone with no rocks, wadis, scrub or relief. In S7 the bottom two-thirds is an even grey-brown sheet. The claimed shrubs and desert-pavement mottling are invisible at these distances. Iron Harvest and CoH3 never leave half the screen as a flat albedo, and TW:WH3 foregrounds always carry rock, relief or vegetation.

The regional roads render as blue-black tubes that look raised above the ground. In S7 the Route 31 line and the long diagonal look like cables lying on the desert. In S1 a dark navy rope curves in from the left. The town.js comment says far asphalt should read as a pale grey line, but in the shots it is the darkest value in the scene, and it is cold blue against the warm ground.

The plateau still ends in a ruler-straight horizontal line against the far ridge in S3 and S6. There is no visible drop, rift haze or cliff band, so the mid-ground layer (escarpment and Dead Sea) is missing from both frames, and the composition goes straight from flat ground to the ridge. In S6 the far ridge is a flat uniform band, and above it is a huge empty black sky.

Roofs are still flat grey slabs with a single box and a red dot, repeated across buildings. The rooftop clutter claimed to be bigger is not readable at S4 zoom. The block interiors are flat brown, and the scrub decals are square yellow-green tiles with hard edges. The battery vehicles in S3 are simple box clusters.
